project_title: Interactive Pastel Pink Birthday Surprise Website
emotional_archetype: Pastel & Romantic Playful (Warm, Magical, Emotional, Interactive)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-pink-950/40 border border-white/60 dark:border-pink-500/20 shadow-xl shadow-pink-500/5
visual_enhancers.floating_hearts_bg: Continuous floating heart canvas / SVG particle overlay with random float-up animations, varying sizes, and soft opacity
visual_enhancers.card_effects: Soft 3D card flips (180deg Y-rotation), polaroid hover tilts (-3deg to +3deg), light-beam highlights on active cards
visual_enhancers.confetti_fireworks: canvas-confetti integration on candle blow and celebration screen reveal with custom pink, gold, and heart-shaped particles

key_sections.name: Welcome Screen
features: Headline: 'Happy Birthday Beautiful ❤️🎂'
Subtext: 'A magical journey created just for you on your special day'
CTA Button: 'Start The Surprise' with pulsing heart glow and audio auto-prompt
Floating decorative elements: Balloons, sparkles, background soft glow rings
Data attribute: data-testid='hero-start-surprise-button'

key_sections.name: Animated Love Letter
features: Interactive wax-sealed pink envelope that opens with smooth 3D unfolding animation on tap/click
Letter paper pulls out with typewriter text effect revealing personal romantic birthday message
Controls: Pause/Resume typewriter, Replay animation, Skip to full text
Decorations: Dried flower stem visual accent, wax seal icon, romantic background lighting

key_sections.name: 12 Reasons Why You're Amazing
features: Grid of 12 interactive 3D flip cards
Front side: Number tag, subtle cute icon (heart, star, crown, spark), hover tilt
Back side: Heartfelt reason text, romantic background pattern
Global Controls: 'Reveal Next' (reveals in order) and 'Reveal All' buttons
Progress indicator: e.g. '4 of 12 Reasons Unlocked ✨'

key_sections.name: Our Memory Timeline
features: Vertical progress line with animated glowing heart tracker as user scrolls
Alternating left/right slide-in cards for memory milestones
Card content: Date badge, location/title, memory quote, polaroid thumbnail
Micro-interactions: Hover zoom on milestone image, tap to open lightbox

key_sections.name: Polaroid Masonry Gallery
features: Masonry style layout with realistic polaroid frames (white border, tape on corners, handwritten caption)
Random subtle rotations (-2deg, +3deg, -1deg) for authentic scattered photo feel
Interactive Lightbox modal: Full image preview, zoom option, image description, and 'Send Heart Reaction' button with bursting heart animation

key_sections.name: Interactive Birthday Cake Studio
features: Step 1: Select Flavor (Strawberry Blush, Chocolate Fudge, Vanilla Blossom, Pistachio Dream) - dynamic color changing cake layers
Step 2: Add Candles (Interactive slider or tap to add 1-10 candles on top of cake)
Step 3: Light Candles (Tap match/lighter or auto-light with flickering flame animations)
Step 4: 'Make A Wish' & Blow Candles Out - blow detection simulation or tap button -> flame switches to soft smoke particles
Triggers grand confetti celebration once candles are blown out

key_sections.name: Celebration Screen & Final Message
features: Explosion of colorful heart confetti & sparkles across screen
Floating balloons floating up into the sky
Grand banner: 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY ❤️'
Final emotional message card: 'You make every day brighter.'
Footer: 'Made with Love by [Name]' with animated pulsing heart
Replay entire surprise button

key_sections.name: Persistent Floating Controls
features: Floating Music Player: Rotating vinyl disc with play/pause, volume toggle, track switcher, and animated audio wave bars
Floating Sticky Nav: Quick jumps to sections (Hero, Letter, Reasons, Memories, Gallery, Cake)
Theme Toggle: Switch between Pastel Light and Velvet Midnight Dark mode
Overall Experience Progress Bar at top of viewport

background_decorations.description: Soft pastel cherry blossoms for letter background

transitions.page_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll or native smooth scroll behavior

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on buttons, cards, audio controls, theme toggle, lightbox, and cake step inputs

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a modular single-page app architecture under src/components (Header, Hero, Letter, ReasonsGrid, Timeline, Gallery, CakeBuilder, Celebration, MusicPlayer, FloatingNav).
Ensure all text and memory content is centralized in a clean editable JSON/js configuration file (src/data/birthdayData.js).
Integrate canvas-confetti for the grand candle blow blowout celebration.
Support both light and dark mode with crisp glassmorphism cards and pastel pink accent glowing gradients.
Implement data-testid on all key interactive elements.
